prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1255; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align well with a cervical strain. Physical examination and imaging findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical region. Over the course of care, the patient attended 19 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury. The patient also had prior treatment for the same body area within the last two years, and that earlier condition appears to contribute to some of the current complaints. Two similar billing entries on the same date of service are under review to confirm accuracy. Current plan includes continued home exercise, activity modification, and reassessment to determine whether further active care remains necessary.
